warranty.notes: 70% of initial usable capacity at 10 years from installation (max. 126 months from manufacture) or the cumulative discharging throughput, whichever comes first. Applies to batteries installed on or after 1 October 2024. The warranty says the throughput limit applies to uses other than daily self-consumption and backup (those have unlimited cycles); BatteryLedger applies it in all cases, which is conservative.
